warnings.detail: The raw artifacts do not record the repository commit used when the game ran; the intake/analysis source commit is recorded separately.
No run/responses/ directory exists. All 401 raw response JSON artifacts are preserved in run/prompts/ alongside parsed/request artifacts.
No run_manifest.json exists; configuration/provenance is split across run_config.json, experiment_manifest.json, players.json, seat_assignment.json, and artifact_manifest.json.
No provider_route_summary.csv exists. Requested routes are in experiment_manifest.json and observed providers/models are preserved in resolved decision raw responses.
The artifacts explicitly record max-token omission and reasoning effort, but do not independently record whether temperature was omitted or sent.
Prompt/response files do not each carry an embedded hash field. The freeze manifest supplies byte-level SHA-256 for every file.
Raw total_tokens equals input_tokens + output_tokens; reasoning_tokens are reported separately and are not added again.
summary.json reports 4.652755 USD while OpenRouter actual call rows and usage.json report 4.65275495 USD (rounding difference 0.00000005 USD).

tooling_defects.detail: The shared standardizer formats USD axes with zero decimal places, collapsing sub-dollar ticks and repeating rounded labels. Exactly four cost plots were regenerated from canonical CSV tables with two-decimal USD axes; shared code and raw evidence were not changed.
